message: 一緒に心配

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Demon Lord, today's Sunday, ya know? Ain't no need to come to school」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to come in even without classes」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't it a lil' early to be pickin' up ginkgo nuts?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ginkgo nuts are hard to pass up, sure, but I came to see if Lolotte is here」

name: Synn
message: 「Last night, we ran into some ridiculously strong demons, remember?」

name: Synn
message: 「We managed to drive them off, but... Lolotte was acting strange during the fight」

name: Paqy
message: 「That angel's always actin' strange, ain't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking just at how she talks and acts, sure, Lolotte seems full of energy? Still, it feels like something's been weighing on her mind the whole time」

name: Paqy
message: 「That worry of yours is way too vague. Even if ya do run into the angel here, how're ya plannin' to approach her?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I'm thinking of just talking about all sorts of things without overcalculating」

name: Synn
message: 「See, I don't know anything at all about angels' inner worlds, right? So no matter how much I think it over, I won't be able to understand her」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hoh... Bein' properly aware of what ya don't understand--that's our Demon Lord for ya」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you praising me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Means if ya can grasp that much, ya can get along with anyone across the Three Realms」

name: Paqy
message: 「C'mon, let's go look for the angel」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!? W-who's there!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Did I get the wrong classroom?」

name: Misa
message: 「You've got the right one. This is Class 1-D, Lolotte-san's classroom」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph-hmph, so you were worried and came to check up on her too, Sakura-kun? Too bad I beat you to it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oi, Hiss? The angel herself ain't even here. Early or late, that's way before any talk of winnin' or losin'」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness, I'm not the only one! You're looking for Lolotte too, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Since she wasn't in the Student Council room, I assumed she'd be here...」

name: Misa
message: 「You are the president, after all, so naturally you've noticed, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lately, whenever Lolotte is alone, she looks out toward Ryuusei Town with a completely absentminded expression.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I hadn't noticed that much detail.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! You ought to worry about Lolotte a little more!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I am worrying. Paqy is too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I ain't worried, y'know? Though what you and Hisu are frettin' over is pretty much the same thing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That angel doesn't understand the Human World, yet she accepts it, right? Not just in theory, but in reality.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And it's the same for you and Hisu, making an angel your ally, see? That's why it'll be fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm? That's too complicated for me to understand. What about you, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-O-O-Of course I'm convinced! After all, it's coming from Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh-ho?」

name: Misa
message: 「...What is it!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Let's see what Hisu's made of, Synn-sama!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're being mean, Paqy. We don't even know the reason why Lolotte's been so distracted, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if we meet her, she might not open up about her troubles, and we could just end up chatting.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's completely fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Simply talking with someone can unexpectedly lift your spirits. You might even stumble upon a hint.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Yeah! Let's look for Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「How about the library? When it opens on weekends, Riesling often comes by to borrow books.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good idea. Lolotte will likely be there with her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's head over too.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, you really are a hopeless person.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Don't go out at the same time, we're gonna get stuck!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we push just a little harder, looks like we can make it straight into the hallway?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaa!? Where are you touching, you pervert!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhah」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku...」
